svg.title: Muse Gadget for macOS: pair on your phone, test on your Mac
svg.desc: The Muse phone app pairs with a Mac once over Bluetooth. The Muse agent then handles requests & updates to the Mac over an encrypted Internet session, and a local browser preview shows the result.
svg.text: Pair on your phone. Test on your Mac.
A native Bluetooth adapter and a live local preview for the Muse Gadget SDK.
Native macOS CoreBluetooth enables pairing. The SDK carries requests and updates over an encrypted Internet connection.
